failure_modes.recovery: Call invoice_payment_list with the invoice_id to find the payment id.
failure_modes.when: id does not name a live payment in your tenant

failure_modes.recovery: The reversal is parked for the account owner to approve in the Simpler UI.
failure_modes.when: an agent actor attempts the reversal (retiring money facts is human-approved)

failure_modes.recovery: Retire the credit note the refusal names first (invoice_adjustment_delete with its id, approval required), then retire the payment.
failure_modes.when: a credit note refunded outside Simpler still needs this payment (refunds cannot be more than the payments left)

failure_modes.recovery: Read the invoice back with invoice_read, then retry the retire if it still applies.
failure_modes.when: the invoice's payments or refunds changed while this payment was being retired (reason_code SIMPLER_SALES_PAYMENT_DELETE_RACED); nothing was changed

preconditions: Payments are append-only — a wrong payment is retired (approval required), never edited. Re-record the correct one with invoice_payment_record.
If retiring the payment un-settles the invoice, the reversal moves paid→sent itself — the status re-derives from the ledger.

description: [REQUIRES APPROVAL] Retires a payment fact row — the only correction lane (payments are append-only; amounts are never edited). If retiring it un-settles the invoice, the reversal itself rolls the status from 'paid' back to 'sent' and clears paid_at. An agent's call parks here for a human to approve in the Simpler UI; a human's call is its own approval. NEXT: invoice_payment_record to re-record the correct amount.
name: invoice_payment_delete
